title: Developer Onboarding
text:
single source of truth: issues/contributing.md on github. this page is the readable version that guide.
what hax
hax (headless authoring experience) an experience enables rapid creation fast, static, file-backed websites. it seeks to be smallest possible back-end cms make hax editor work and able build websites with it. leveraging json outline schema, authors multiple pages writes them onto file system, so a slim server layer only needed for basic authentication, saving files, placing in control.
get all details at haxtheweb.org.
the ecosystem glance
hax many repos. core three below are what you clone get started; rest listed know whats out there.

haxcms-nodejs â node.js backend haxcms (content management + apis). usually fastest way see running.
webcomponents heart hax: monorepo 250+ litelement web components, themes, ddd design system. where most component happens.
create (@haxtheweb/create) cli scaffolding components haxsites managing dev workflow.
haxcms-php (optional) php haxcms; same capabilities, different stack (php 8.3+ / apache). those who prefer stack.
docs official documentation site (a itself), haxtheweb.org.
issues unified issue queue entire ecosystem, plus canonical onboarding guide.
hax11ty, json-outline-schema, hax-schema supporting repos (11ty integration, content property schema).

prerequisites

os: macos or linux need nothing special. windows developers should use wsl 2 ubuntu (open microsoft store select install/update, run --update powershell).
git github account (you'll fork open pull requests).
node.js 22 higher. we recommend fnm as cross-platform node manager (fnm install --lts --use). nvm works too.
npm (ships node) yarn (npm -g yarn) webcomponents uses yarn; other npm.
windows extra: enable developer mode (windows settings â mode) symlinks without running administrator. emulate live haxsite locally.

haxcms-nodejs
the haxcms. quickest locally.
fork (replace your_username):
mkdir -p ~/documents/git/haxtheweb
cd ~/documents/git/haxtheweb
git https://github.com/your_username/haxcms-nodejs.git
cd haxcms-nodejs
git remote add upstream https://github.com/haxtheweb/haxcms-nodejs.git
install start:
npm install
npm start
visit http://localhost:3000 (it opens automatically). interface load. confirms running.
webcomponents
the contributions happen.
fork clone:
cd https://github.com/your_username/webcomponents.git
cd webcomponents
git https://github.com/haxtheweb/webcomponents.git
install (uses yarn, from repo root):
yarn install
start server:
yarn start
open http://localhost:8000/elements/haxcms-elements/demo/ development interface. component, another terminal cd elements/<elementname> && dev, which watches rebuilds element while still running.
for monorepo-specific detail (build commands, lerna, audits, testing, troubleshooting, theme development), webcomponents/contributing.md.
create
the haxsites.
fork https://github.com/your_username/create.git
cd create
git https://github.com/haxtheweb/create.git
install:
npm install
get command globally it's available everywhere:
npm @haxtheweb/create --global
verify: start interactive (ascii art via clack) scaffolds haxsites. itself: npm ./dist/create.js.

  haxcms-php (optional alternative backend)
 
 capabilities version, stack. skip unless want backend.
 clone:
 https://github.com/your_username/haxcms-php.git
cd haxcms-php
git https://github.com/haxtheweb/haxcms-php.git
 prerequisites (one two paths):
 native php:
 8.3 higher curl, zip, gd, xml modules installed
 apache 2.4
 container-based (recommended most):
 container runtime docker, ddev, docksal, lando, vagrant
 quick (script):
 curl -fssl https://raw.githubusercontent.com/haxtheweb/haxcms-php/master/scripts/haxcmsme.sh -o haxcmsme.sh sh haxcmsme.sh
 path (ddev example):
 ddev start
 url prints. log admin confirm working. runtimes fin init (docksal), lando magic (lando), vagrant up (vagrant).
 full php/container instructions, haxcms-php/readme.md.
 

where find issues
all bugs features one queue:

issue queue: github.com/haxtheweb/issues/issues
new contributors: look new here good first labels.
documentation issues often beginner-friendly.

before starting issue, comment saying you'd like wait maintainer acknowledgment avoid duplicate work.
join community

discord (real-time help discussion): discord.gg/ekyjajqghf
youtube (tutorials): youtube.com/@haxtheweb
try browser: hax.cloud

next steps

repo-specific contributing (monorepo workflow, code standards, pr conventions monorepo): webcomponents/contributing.md
full documentation: haxtheweb.org
scaffold your component: webcomponent my-element --y
scaffold haxsite: mysite --y
run party ways more involved.

contributing conventions
we primarily requests forks.

fork contribute to; pointing associated issue.
reference resolves body (e.g. fixes #123). do not put @mentions keywords commit messages body.
write clear messages; squash small prs (typos, style) into commit.
code style: pure javascript (no typescript), quotes, semicolons, globalthis over window, es module imports. auto-formatted prettier commit.
web components: <name> --y create elements (never hand-create ensures uniform packaging). adhere system; audit root before submitting.
testing: test (webcomponents) per opening pr.

community pillars reflected cycle
hax development evaluated against seven community pillars. here how maps them:

accessible: wcag 2.0 aa components, a11y-media-player transcript support, video so uncaptioned gets surfaced.
efficient: 8,127 through polyfill, polymer, wiredjs removal; fixes lazy loading keep fast.
free open: migration keeps content calls own infrastructure, extends 5rs oer.
extensible: app-store editor make stretch further without forking.
platform agnostic: publish-to-surge, netlify, vercel reach anywhere.
remixable: import/export, docx pipelines, semantic structures sites portable re-mixable.
sustainable: less data lower battery use code reduction, web standards over heavy libraries, inclusive governance.
